comment: Every authored asset the maze may load. MazeAssets.js loads ONLY what is declared here; scripts/tests/maze-assets.test.mjs holds every entry to the licence allow-list (CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0 with attribution, proprietary-owned, generated) and to the batch geometry reservations. A file missing at runtime degrades to the procedural prefab - see MazeAssets.js.
